document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You, Norman, and Sylvia carry Bernard to the shelter of the 
glade and try to warm him up. It does no good. He enters a 
coma and dies at dusk.

You  get  very  little  sleep  that  night.  Your  remaining 
companions turn, restless in their bedrolls. At first light, you 
bury Bernard in the glade.
To continue exploring the valley, go to 551. To leave it, go to 291.
